outcome: Duration of labor (total, first stage, second stage)
cohort: 1885 nulliparous women with a single cephalic presentation from 37 0/7 to 42 6/7 weeks of completed gestation and spontaneous or induced labor at Nordsjællands Hospital, University of Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2011 and 2012
finding: While BMI did not significantly affect the duration of active labor, the risk of cesarean delivery increased significantly with increasing BMI.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries were performed earlier in labor in obese women compared to normal-weight women, contributing to a shorter total duration of active labor in the obese group.
